services.desc: Have the time of your life creating memories that last a lifetime with your family and friends. Fishing boat rentals are for people fishing ONLY. services.name: Why Wake Surf?
services.desc: In the 1950s, what began as a way to recreate the feeling of ocean surfing behind a boat has evolved significantly. First let’s start with the wake. A wake is the wave that any watercraft puts out on the water as it moves across the surface. One would be an attachment on the side of the boat that creates a consistent wake large enough to surf. Pontoon boats are also excellent for company outings and team building events. For added excitement rent one of our lay down or sit in tubes. Two person sit on tubes are safe and less intimidating for small children. For some faster fun rent on of our jet skis (also known as WaveRunners) or one of our water ski / wakeboard boats.
